title: Florida Man Court
description:
In Florida, court is still in session, even while someone is getting punched in the face.Florida Man Court™ is a multiplayer courtroom party game where serious courtroom arguments collide with unbelievable Florida insanity. 

Play as the Judge, Prosecutor, Defense Attorney, Bailiff, or Juror. Present evidence, interrogate the defendant, shout objections, and build the strongest case you can while surviving fistfights, tasers, hungry jurors, and a courthouse that is barely functioning, even by Florida standards.

You'll need quick thinking, sharp arguments, and just enough creativity to convince everyone your completely ridiculous version of events actually makes sense.

Watch your back. Chomps, the resident courthouse alligator, is always nearby, and the wildly unpredictable Florida Man and Lady Florida Man defendants are known to lash out without provocation.

Every trial begins with a series of outrageous testimony prompts. Players build the official court record one answer at a time by creating alibis, failed polygraphs, suspicious evidence, and increasingly unbelievable explanations.

Once the testimony is locked in, both attorneys battle over the meaning of that testimony and evidence.

The Prosecutor(s) argues it proves guilt.

The Defense Team argues it proves something completely different.

Finally, both sides deliver their closing arguments and invent the Florida Man headline they believe best explains the testimony.

The Judge or Jury decides which story deserves the verdict.

No two trials ever tell the same story.

Features• Multiplayer courtroom party game with improvised roleplaying

• Play as the Judge, Bailiff, Prosecutor, Defense Attorney, or Juror

• Outrageous testimony prompts create a brand-new case every game

• Invent competing Florida Man headlines during closing arguments

• Courtroom polygraph, evidence and more

• Interrogate unpredictable Florida Man defendants

• Handcuff troublemakers, tase offenders, throw punches, or start a courtroom brawl

• Dynamic courtroom chaos with hunger, thirst, health, and survival mechanics

• Interact with Chomps, the courthouse alligator... at your own risk

• Public matchmaking and password protected (private) lobbies

• Voice chat friendly chaos

Live fast. Have fun. Florida hard.
description_short: Florida Man Court™ is a multiplayer courtroom party game where outrageous testimony becomes believable... if you're a good enough lawyer. Present evidence, interrogate the defendant, survive courtroom chaos, and convince the Judge your completely unhinged story deserves the verdict.
